actionShortSummaryName.description: Nombre de la acción por defecto Resumen corto

actionShortSummaryPrompt.message:
Please provide a brief summary in English of approximately 8 to 10 lines of the transcript of the following YouTube video titled "{{titulo}}".

Write the summary in continuous prose, in a single block of text without headings, bullet points, introductions, or preambles. Focus solely on extracting the essential content of the video.

---

FULL TRANSCRIPT:
{{transcripcion}}
actionShortSummaryPrompt.description: Prompt de la acción por defecto Resumen corto

actionExtendedSummaryName.description: Nombre de la acción por defecto Resumen extendido

actionExtendedSummaryPrompt.message:
Please analyze the following transcript of the YouTube video titled "{{titulo}}" and generate:

1. An executive summary (3-4 sentences).
2. The 5-7 key points with explanatory bullets.
3. Actionable takeaways or conclusions.

Format everything with clear Markdown using H2 and H3 headings, and bold for important concepts.

---

FULL TRANSCRIPT:
{{transcripcion}}

actionDataReferencesName.description: Nombre de la acción por defecto Datos y referencias

actionDataReferencesPrompt.message:
From the video "{{titulo}}" and the following transcript, extract only verifiable information explicitly cited: figures and statistics, studies or sources, proper names, books, tools, and links mentioned.

Present it in a list, clearly indicating if any important statement lacks a cited source in the video. Do not include opinions or summaries.

Transcript:
{{transcripcion}}
